**This issue is public.** Do not share credentials, private correspondence, logs, account details or publisher-derived data. Sensitive security reports belong in [private security reporting](https://github.com/dmoliveira/wrap-brief/security/advisories/new).

## Reader or operator problem

Describe the concrete problem and relevant stable backlog task ID, if one exists.

## Smallest useful change

Suggest a bounded slice and synthetic acceptance example. Explain why existing components do not cover it.

## Validation and gates

What observable check would prove the improvement? Identify any permissions, privacy, hosting, source-rights or budget dependency. A proposal must not assume live collection, paid services, tracking or commercial scopes are enabled.
